description: This is a PHP source file defining the class PinpointEmailClient within the Aws\PinpointEmail namespace. The class extends AwsClient and contains method annotations for interacting with the Amazon Pinpoint Email Service API, including creating, deleting, retrieving configurations, reputation, send emails, and other related operations.
